entries.name: A. D. King

expected.charges: Anti-trespass / breach of peace / Anti-Mask Act — Atlanta sit-ins
expected.sentence: Arrested in the Atlanta sit-in demonstrations

entries.rationale: The Atlanta sit-in case has May 8, 1918 as incarceration, twelve years before his verified July 30, 1930 birth. Remove this impossible date. Existing case text identifies March 1960, so do not substitute the separately documented October 1960 arrest or invent a day. Exact March detention and release remain unresolved.

entries.name: A. D. King

expected.sentence: Five days in jail and a $50 fine for contempt, upheld on appeal. Taken into custody at Birmingham airport October 30, 1967 and held in Jefferson County Jail. Released early on November 3, 1967, before a planned vigil, by Judge William Barber; the actual custody interval was shorter than the five-day sentence.

entries.rationale: The existing 12-month duration override blocks calculation from the verified October 30-November 3, 1967 custody interval. Contemporary Southern Courier confirms early release after less than four days of a five-day sentence, not one year. Remove the unsupported override and recalculate.
